---
title: "Confidence intervals: an interactive coverage simulation"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

This simulation uses a population we completely know: a normal distribution
with population mean $\mu = 0$ and standard deviation $\sigma = 1$.
Each trial draws a new random sample, calculates its sample mean, and creates
an approximate 95% confidence interval for $\mu$.

Throughout this page, $\mu$ denotes the fixed population mean (the quantity we
want to learn), while $\bar{X}$ denotes the sample mean (our estimate of it).

The dashed vertical line marks the true population mean. Blue intervals contain
it; red intervals miss it. A 95% confidence level describes the *long-run
behavior of this procedure*: across many independently constructed intervals,
about 95% should contain $\mu$. It does not guarantee that any particular
interval will do so.

For each sample, the simulation constructs the approximate 95% confidence
interval

$$
\bar{X} \pm 1.96 \frac{S}{\sqrt{n}},
$$

where $\bar{X}$ is the sample mean, $S$ is the sample standard deviation, and
$n$ is the sample size. The sample standard deviation is calculated from the
same $n$ observations:

$$
S = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n - 1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(X_i - \bar{X}\right)^2}.
$$

::: {.callout-tip}
## Try this

Begin with a few intervals, then add more. The occasional red interval makes
the meaning of “95% confidence” visible. Reset and repeat: the exact number of
misses changes each time, while the long-run pattern remains near 95% coverage.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="ci-explorer" class="ci-explorer" aria-label="Confidence interval coverage simulation">
  <div class="ci-controls">
    <label>
      <span>Sample size, <i>n</i> (2–500)</span>
      <input id="ci-sample-size" type="number" min="2" max="500" step="1" value="30" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Intervals to show, <i>B</i> (1–100)</span>
      <input id="ci-total-intervals" type="number" min="1" max="100" step="1" value="100" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      Add intervals
      <select id="ci-batch-size">
        <option value="1">1</option>
        <option value="5" selected>5</option>
        <option value="10">10</option>
        <option value="20">20</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="ci-buttons" aria-label="Simulation controls">
    <button id="ci-add" type="button">Add intervals</button>
    <button id="ci-run" type="button">Run remaining intervals</button>
    <button id="ci-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p id="ci-status" class="ci-status" aria-live="polite">No intervals yet. Add a small batch to begin.</p>

  <figure class="ci-plot">
    <figcaption>Confidence intervals for the population mean <span class="ci-legend"><span class="ci-legend-covered"></span>contains &mu; <span class="ci-legend-missed"></span>misses &mu;</span></figcaption>
    <svg id="ci-interval-plot" role="img" aria-label="Repeated 95 percent confidence intervals and the true population mean"></svg>
  </figure>
</div>
```

<a href="index.qmd">← Return to Foundations</a>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("ci-explorer");
  if (!root) return;

  const populationMean = 0;
  const confidenceMultiplier = 1.96;
  const sampleSizeInput = document.getElementById("ci-sample-size");
  const totalIntervalsInput = document.getElementById("ci-total-intervals");
  const batchSizeInput = document.getElementById("ci-batch-size");
  const addButton = document.getElementById("ci-add");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("ci-run");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("ci-reset");
  const status = document.getElementById("ci-status");
  const plot = document.getElementById("ci-interval-plot");

  let intervals = [];

  const clamp = (value, lower, upper) => Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value));
  const getSampleSize = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(sampleSizeInput.value, 10) || 30, 2, 500);
  const getTotalIntervals = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(totalIntervalsInput.value, 10) || 100, 1, 100);

  function normalRandom() {
    const u = 1 - Math.random();
    const v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  function createInterval() {
    const n = getSampleSize();
    const sample = Array.from({ length: n }, normalRandom);
    const mean = sample.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / n;
    const sumSquaredDeviations = sample.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2, 0);
    const standardError = Math.sqrt(sumSquaredDeviations / (n - 1)) / Math.sqrt(n);
    const margin = confidenceMultiplier * standardError;
    const lower = mean - margin;
    const upper = mean + margin;
    return { mean, lower, upper, containsMean: lower <= populationMean && populationMean <= upper };
  }

  function svgElement(tag, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    plot.append(element);
  }

  function renderPlot() {
    const width = Math.max(320, Math.round(plot.getBoundingClientRect().width || 900));
    const rowHeight = 6;
    const margin = { top: 30, right: 26, bottom: 34, left: 46 };
    const height = Math.max(250, margin.top + margin.bottom + Math.max(intervals.length, 20) * rowHeight);
    const visibleIntervals = intervals;
    const extremes = visibleIntervals.flatMap(interval => [interval.lower, interval.upper]);
    const extent = extremes.length ? Math.max(0.5, ...extremes.map(value => Math.abs(value))) : 0.5;
    const domainExtent = Math.ceil((extent + 0.08) * 2) / 2;
    const domain = [-domainExtent, domainExtent];
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const x = value => margin.left + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * plotWidth;
    const y = index => margin.top + (index + 0.5) * (plotHeight / Math.max(visibleIntervals.length, 20));

    plot.replaceChildren();
    plot.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    plot.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    plot.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: height - margin.bottom, x2: width - margin.right, y2: height - margin.bottom, class: "ci-axis" }));
    plot.append(svgElement("line", { x1: x(populationMean), y1: margin.top, x2: x(populationMean), y2: height - margin.bottom, class: "ci-population-line" }));

    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i += 1) {
      const value = domain[0] + (i / 4) * (domain[1] - domain[0]);
      const tickX = x(value);
      plot.append(svgElement("line", { x1: tickX, y1: height - margin.bottom, x2: tickX, y2: height - margin.bottom + 4, class: "ci-axis" }));
      addText(Number(value.toFixed(1)).toString(), tickX, height - 12, { class: "ci-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }
    addText("true population mean, μ = 0", Math.min(x(populationMean) + 5, width - 145), 16, { class: "ci-annotation" });

    visibleIntervals.forEach((interval, index) => {
      const rowY = y(index);
      const className = interval.containsMean ? "ci-covered" : "ci-missed";
      plot.append(svgElement("line", { x1: x(interval.lower), y1: rowY, x2: x(interval.upper), y2: rowY, class: className }));
      plot.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: x(interval.mean), cy: rowY, r: 2.2, class: `${className}-point` }));
    });

    if (!visibleIntervals.length) {
      addText("Each new trial will add one 95% confidence interval here.", width / 2, height / 2, { class: "ci-empty-message", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }
  }

  function render() {
    const total = getTotalIntervals();
    const completed = intervals.length;
    const covered = intervals.filter(interval => interval.containsMean).length;
    const remaining = total - completed;
    renderPlot();
    status.textContent = completed
      ? `${covered} of ${completed} intervals contain μ = 0 (${(100 * covered / completed).toFixed(1)}% coverage).`
      : "No intervals yet. Add a small batch to begin.";
    addButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
    runButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
  }

  function addIntervals(requested) {
    const total = getTotalIntervals();
    const numberToAdd = Math.min(requested, Math.max(0, total - intervals.length));
    for (let index = 0; index < numberToAdd; index += 1) intervals.push(createInterval());
    render();
  }

  function reset() {
    sampleSizeInput.value = getSampleSize();
    totalIntervalsInput.value = getTotalIntervals();
    intervals = [];
    render();
  }

  addButton.addEventListener("click", () => addIntervals(Number.parseInt(batchSizeInput.value, 10)));
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => addIntervals(getTotalIntervals() - intervals.length));
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", reset);
  [sampleSizeInput, totalIntervalsInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener("change", reset));
  window.addEventListener("resize", render);
  reset();
})();
</script>
